**Release decision: Hold publication. The inventory guide is draft.**

The link in [README.md](<assignment>/work/README.md:3) reaches the moved guide. The command in [guide.md](<assignment>/work/guide.md:3), `node bin/inventory.mjs --items`, exits `64` with `unsupported inventory option` on stderr and empty stdout. On Node.js v24.15.0 on Linux x86_64, `node bin/inventory.mjs --list` exited `0` and printed `Product A`, as required by [PROJECT.md](<assignment>/work/PROJECT.md:1).

The [CI receipt](<assignment>/work/.local/check.json:1) records a passing `sh bin/check-links` run covering local Markdown links and fragments across all three Markdown files at the exact reviewed revision, `6ce23c6c749e5dd0a4d80fffc914c0b7ef27719d`. I reused that result. The checkout is clean.

Restore `--list` in the guide, then verify the reader path and the required Markdown gate on the corrected revision before publication.
